### Words That Harm
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/words-that-harm.html
Passage: James 3:6, 8
Points:
- Spoken words cannot be recalled, and every careless statement will face divine accountability.
- Harsh and reckless words cause enduring emotional injuries that far outlast physical wounds.
- Harmful speech shatters relationships and homes because its destructive power originates from hell.
- Taming the tongue is impossible through mere human willpower and requires the Holy Spirit.
- Believers must examine their daily speech, repent of hurtful words, and choose to speak life.

### Be Wise with Your Words
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-september-5-2020.html
Passage: James 3:5-6
Points:
- A lack of verbal self-control makes the tongue the foremost destroyer of human relationships.
- Just as a tiny spark ignites a forest fire, a careless remark can burn down trust.
- Destructive talk and gossip spread rapidly, ruining careers, families, and friendships.
- Christians should intentionally replace criticism with words that affirm and build others up.
- Choosing disciplined, uplifting speech reflects the glory of God in a dark world.
